channel.title: Late Brake blog
channel.description: Formula 1 news, history, fun facts and what happened on this day.

item.title: F1 to show drivers' heart rates on TV as Verstappen opts out
item.description: F1 has signed WHOOP to put drivers' heart-rate data on live broadcasts from 2027, but Max Verstappen says he will not take part.

item.title: On this day: Moss wins at Riverside and Vettel bows out in Abu Dhabi
item.description: On 20 November Stirling Moss won the 1960 United States Grand Prix from pole, and in 2022 Sebastian Vettel scored a point in his final F1 race.

item.title: FIA to bring in full-time F1 stewards from 2027
item.description: The FIA will hire its first full-time F1 stewards in 2027 and build to a group of 12 to 15, in a bid to make race decisions more consistent.

item.title: Six F1 facts about American teams that sound made up
item.description: A beard lost on a bet, a win a week after Le Mans, two different Haas teams and a team that never turned a wheel: six true stories of American F1 teams.

item.title: Piastri to take 10-place grid penalty at F1 Las Vegas GP
item.description: McLaren's Oscar Piastri will drop 10 places on the Las Vegas grid after needing a fifth engine of the 2026 season following a reliability problem.

item.title: On this day: Adams and Lotterer, Spa's one-off F1 drivers, born
item.description: Two drivers born on 19 November made brief F1 appearances at Spa: Belgium's Philippe Adams in 1994 and Le Mans winner André Lotterer in 2014.

item.title: Bottas keeps his Cadillac F1 seat for 2027 ahead of Herta
item.description: Cadillac will keep Valtteri Bottas alongside Sergio Perez in 2027, choosing him over test driver Colton Herta and completing next year's F1 grid.

item.title: How Keke Rosberg won the 1982 F1 title with a single victory
item.description: In F1's most unpredictable season, Keke Rosberg won just once but sealed the 1982 title for Williams in a Las Vegas car park.

item.title: Mercedes to give only Antonelli new turbo at F1 Las Vegas GP
item.description: Mercedes will run its upgraded ADUO turbo on Kimi Antonelli's car in Las Vegas, but not on George Russell's, to protect his grid position.

item.title: On this day: Hamilton wins Austin's first race, F1 returns to Vegas
item.description: On 18 November, Lewis Hamilton won the first F1 race at Austin in 2012 and Max Verstappen won F1's return to Las Vegas in 2023.

item.title: Alonso to race the 2027 Dakar Rally for Aston Martin
item.description: Two-time F1 champion Fernando Alonso will lead Aston Martin's first factory Dakar entry in January, alongside Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes.

item.title: Six F1 British Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A shared win, a wartime airfield and a chequered flag shown a lap early: six true stories from the F1 British Grand Prix.

item.title: Williams to race one-off chrome livery at F1 Las Vegas GP
item.description: Williams will run a special chrome livery on its FW48s at this weekend's F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, designed with title partner Atlassian.

item.title: On this day: Vettel's record eighth win and Sainz's first podium
item.description: On 17 November, Sebastian Vettel set a record run of wins in Austin in 2013 and Carlos Sainz took his first podium from last at Interlagos in 2019.

item.title: Haas keeps Camara for F1 Las Vegas GP as Hirakawa returns for FP1
item.description: Rafael Camara will race for Haas again at the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, while Ryo Hirakawa drives Ollie Bearman's car in first practice.

item.title: How Mansell hunted down Piquet to win at Silverstone in 1987
item.description: Nigel Mansell stopped for fresh tyres, fell nearly half a minute behind his Williams team-mate Nelson Piquet and still won the 1987 British Grand Prix.

item.title: Istanbul Park doubles paddock and covers stands for F1's return
item.description: Organisers of the Turkish Grand Prix are rebuilding Istanbul Park's paddock and covering its grandstands before F1 returns on 3 October 2027.

item.title: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026: race time in India and full schedule
item.description: The F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix starts at 9:30am India time on Sunday 22 November. Here is every session of the weekend in India time.

item.title: Williams stops developing its 2026 F1 car to focus on 2027
item.description: Williams has left new aerodynamic parts unbuilt and is using race weekends as test sessions, putting its 2027 F1 car ahead of this year's results.

item.title: Six F1 Belgian Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A first race with one entry, twenty wet years in a row and a Grand Prix of two laps: six true stories from the Belgian Grand Prix and Spa.

item.title: How Panis won the 1996 Monaco Grand Prix from 14th on the grid
item.description: Olivier Panis started 14th in a wet Monaco Grand Prix in 1996 and won for Ligier, in a race that had only three cars running at the flag.

item.title: On this day: Berger's Adelaide win and Hamilton's seventh title
item.description: On 15 November, Berger led every lap in Adelaide in 1987, Rosberg won at Interlagos in 2015 and Hamilton took a seventh title in Turkey in 2020.

item.title: McLaren to bring upgrades for 2027 to F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
item.description: McLaren will run new parts on the MCL40 in Las Vegas that it says lay the groundwork for its 2027 car, at a track where it has struggled.

item.title: How Michael Schumacher's F1 career began at Spa in 1991
item.description: A jailed driver, a bicycle lap and a clutch that failed at Eau Rouge: Michael Schumacher's first F1 race lasted less than a lap, but began a record career.

item.title: How Narain Karthikeyan became India's first F1 driver
item.description: From Formula Maruti in India to a Jordan seat in 2005, Narain Karthikeyan's road to F1 ended in fourth place at the strangest race of the decade.

item.title: On this day: Vettel's first title and Hamilton's Interlagos charge
item.description: On 14 November, Vettel became F1's youngest champion in Abu Dhabi in 2010, and Hamilton won from tenth at Interlagos in 2021 after a weekend of penalties.

item.title: FIA court to hear Audi's Tsunoda Monza appeal on 25 November
item.description: The FIA's International Court of Appeal will rule on Audi's challenge to Yuki Tsunoda's Italian Grand Prix point at a closed hearing in Paris.

item.title: Six F1 Austrian Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A 0.05-second finish, a deer on the track, a race that took three starts and a winner who gave away his trophy: six true stories from Spielberg.

item.title: Russell launches fully funded karting academy at Silverstone
item.description: George Russell's GR63 Karting Academy will pick 25 children aged eight and nine for a free eight-round championship at Silverstone in 2027.

item.title: On this day: Schumacher's Adelaide title, Hamilton's rain win
item.description: On 13 November, a collision decided the 1994 F1 title in Adelaide, Vettel's run ended in Abu Dhabi in 2011 and Hamilton won a soaked Interlagos race.
